# Offline Help contract provenance

`offline-help-contract.json` is an original Chromarchy interface contract. It
enumerates the six bounded, bundled text pages, their stable object names, and
small required-phrase anchors used by the offscreen keyboard/accessibility
test. It contains no third-party help content, proprietary UI expression, or
network resource.

The license test separately compares the bundled Chromarchy license page with
the repository's exact `LICENSE` text. Optional Qt and system-codec licensing
remains outside that project-license assertion.
